contact.name: Yıldıray Yıldız
contact.evidence_quote: Yıldıray Yıldız Bilkent University, Department of Mechanical Engineering ... Yıldıray Yıldız is an Associate Professor of Mechanical Engineering at Bilkent University, where he leads the Systems Laboratory. His research centers on modeling human-operator behavior and developing adaptive control architectures for Cyber-Physical Human Systems (CPHS). Through his work, he aims to bridge the gap between human decision-making and autonomous control, enhancing safety and performance in applications ranging from operator assistance to autonomous driving.
